verdict.rationale: Raygun's own docs say it tracks every deployment to identify new errors or regressions (raygun-docs-31), lets teams mark fixed errors as 'Resolved' (raygun-docs-10), and sends alerts via email, Slack or Teams (raygun-docs-48). That establishes a regression-detection capability tied to releases. Nothing shows a resolved error reopening on recurrence or triggering an alert separate from new-issue alerts. Missing for 10: documented automatic reopening of resolved errors when they recur in a newer version, a regression-specific alert type distinct from new-error notifications, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
